title: Will robots take your job? The truth about AI automation

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hey, what if your job is already being automated?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing the workforce faster than most realize.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s not just robots — it’s AI tools replacing repetitive tasks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: GPT-4 can write code, design logos, and even draft reports.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Mid-career professionals in admin and customer service are most at risk.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is to upskill — AI won’t replace you, but it will replace your old skills.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one thing you’ll automate in your job this year?
